title: No source gives the case status history, the transfer from-queue or the decision-record read behind the timeline
source: Legacy story RWB-E1-035 sections 4, 11, 12 and 13; TSD P3 v3 T3.1 (assignment DF-WRK-009 to DF-WRK-040); FSD P3 v4 A2.45; Ownership Map v1 (P3 tables 15, P7 rows); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-03 and DP-18 and R3 default ruling
section: RWB-P3-E1035-APP section 3 Preconditions, section 5 Exception path X9, section 8 BR8 and BR9, section 11 Data, section 12.2 REST operations consumed, section 12.8 Contract fakes
description: The legacy timeline merges four records of one module; in the target three come from other services and three values have no published surface. First, the case state change and the creation item: the legacy story reads the decision_log_entry of its own module, the target keeps the decision record of rwb-decision, and neither the P3 nor the P5 ownership list holds a case status history table, so the source of an item of type status change and of the creation item is not stated. Second, a transfer item shows the from queue, the from owner and the rule version, but assignment holds only queue_id, rule_id and transfer_reason_code with no from-queue column and no rule version, so the detail cannot be composed from a column. Third, the decision-record query that replaces the legacy DecisionLogQuery interface has no path, no time filter and no field list in any source, so the consumed row, the client and three of the AC mocks cannot be closed.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E1-035 section 4 step 4 reads interactions and assignments from P3 tables and decision log entries through the P7 interface; section 12 gives DecisionLogQuery.entriesForCase(UUID, Instant, Instant); section 11 lists DF-DEC-002 to DF-DEC-016 on decision_log_entry and DF-WRK-010 to DF-WRK-016 and DF-WRK-040 on assignment. TSD P3 v3 T3.1 assignment ends at queue_id (DF-WRK-039) and transfer_reason_code (DF-WRK-040) with no from-queue and no rule version. FSD P3 v4 A2.45 gives one timeline scenario wired to RWB-E2-016 and no status-history entity. The context pack for P3 lists 15 owned tables and none of them is a history table, and it lists the decision service as P7 rwb-decision.
proposed: Read the state-change and creation items from the decision records of the case through the rwb-decision decision-record query and add no history table to rwb_case; take the from queue and the from owner from the closed previous assignment row of the same case and the rule version from the decision record of the transfer; publish the decision-record query path, filter and field list in C RWB-P7-E1027-CON.

title: No source fixes the v1.1 timeline item shape, the section state or its version against the RWB-P3-E1023-CON baseline
source: Legacy story RWB-E1-035 sections 12, 13 and 15; TSD P3 v3 Appendix T-A API-P3-003; RWB-P3-E1023-CON section 12.1 (timeline operation and its query parameters); Template and Rules v1 R7.2 s12 and R8.2
section: RWB-P3-E1035-CON section 3 Preconditions, section 7 AC1, AC2 and AC5, section 11 Data, section 12.1 REST operations provided, section 12.8 Contract fakes
description: The baseline document publishes the timeline operation with the query parameters type, from, to, page and size and a TimelinePage, while the legacy story adds the item detail fields reasonCode, fromQueueCode, toQueueCode and ruleId for RWB-E2-016 and a per-section failure that shows MSG-P3-023 while the rest of the page stays. No source states which document owns which field, whether the addition is a minor version inside major version 1, or how a partly failed page is expressed, and the legacy section timeout of 3000 ms is marked assumed in the legacy story itself, so the contract cannot fix the item, the section entry or the version without a default.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E1-035 section 12 lists TimelineItem at, type, summary, by, reference plus the new reasonCode, fromQueueCode, toQueueCode and ruleId recorded with RWB-E2-016; section 13 gives caserecord.section.timeout.ms = 3000 marked assumed and DL11; section 15 gives MSG-P3-023 for a missing source. TSD P3 v3 API-P3-003 gives only query type, from and to with a TimelinePage. RWB-P3-E1023-CON section 12.1 already publishes the timeline path and all five query parameters.
proposed: Publish the timeline addition as version v1.1, an additive minor version inside major version 1 of RWB-P3-E1023-CON, with the item detail fields, the TimelineSection state on a 200 response and the page total; leave the type order, the section timeout and the page size as parameters of rwb-case.
